narrative.overview: A formal, restrained cooperative finance workspace built around clear member identity and traceable account activity. Deep green anchors branch navigation and important actions; paper-toned space and clean white records keep dense operational information calm and legible. The interface uses standard web tables, forms, and navigation. Fine rules organize data, and member numbers travel beside names wherever the current records provide them. The visual language is precise without pretending the screen is a physical ledger. A persistent sidebar control switches between the paper-toned light palette and a deep green charcoal dark palette, with the choice saved on the device.
keyCharacteristics: Deep green navigation with quiet ivory and white work surfaces.
Member and receipt references remain easy to recognize.
LKR values align consistently and use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Reference Travels Rule
rules.body: Keep the member number or receipt reference close to the name or transaction it identifies.

rules.name: The Amounts Stay Comparable Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals and right alignment for financial columns; never invent a missing amount.

rules.name: The Workhorse Type Rule
rules.body: Use system sans for interface copy and reserve tabular numerals for values that staff compare.

rules.name: The Rule Before the Shadow Rule
rules.body: Group financial records with alignment and dividers; reserve shadows for overlays that sit above page content.

dos: Do keep member and receipt references beside the records they identify.
Do use tabular numerals and right-aligned LKR values.
Do use rules and spacing to organize dense records.
Do preserve a visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't fabricate financial values when report data is absent.
Don't make a physical-ledger costume from textures, faux stamps, or ornamental lines.
Don't use decorative gradients or card grids as the page structure.
